newsitem.title: USA: D & K to buy Associated Pharmacies.
newsitem.headline: D & K to buy Associated Pharmacies.

text.p: D&K Wholesale Drug Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to buy Associated Pharmacies Inc, a wholesale pharmaceutical distributor.
Terms of the potential agreement were not disclosed. Officials from D & K were not immediately available to comment further.
Little Rock, Arkansas-based API, which is owned by about 35 independent retail pharmacies, had more than $11.0 million in revenues in the most recent fiscal year, D & K said.
D & K said it expects sales from the group to reach $20 million per year.
The transaction should close by September 30, D & K added.
